# Official Microsoft product icons

Retrieved on 2026-10-14. Original SVG bytes are preserved; no recoloring, path edits, cropping, flipping or rotation.

Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, Power Pages and Power Platform:

- Documentation and permitted use: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/power-platform/guidance/icons
- Official archive: https://download.microsoft.com/download/498606aa-6d27-4f13-aa5c-1401078c153b/Power-Platform-icons-scalable.zip
- Archive members: `Power Platform/{PowerApps,PowerAutomate,Dataverse,PowerPages,PowerPlatform}_scalable.svg`.

Microsoft Fabric and Power BI:

- Documentation and permitted use: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/fabric/fundamentals/icons
- Official archive: https://github.com/microsoft/fabric-samples/blob/main/docs-samples/Icons.zip
- Archive members: `v6.1.0/package/dist/svg/fabric_48_color.svg` and `v6.1.0/package/dist/svg/power_bi_48_color.svg`.

Microsoft retains all rights. The documentation permits these icons for architecture diagrams, training materials and documentation. For the planned hero, use a labelled ecosystem diagram showing products working together. Preserve each product mark; animate positions and connecting elements rather than morphing the product marks into a personal logo. Product names should remain identifiable.

Asset presence is not evidence of Justin's experience with a product. The requested ecosystem illustration is broader than the currently documented project stack. Do not silently add these products to project experience claims.

These files are used in the edited Figma Power Platform animation and the portfolio hero. The Power Platform icon appears in the merged phase; the six product icons appear in the expanded phase.
